info.name: Cart API - Functional Scenarios
info.description: Run all folders in order with Collection Runner and the Local - Cart API environment. A fresh set of cart IDs is generated by the first request on each run. Tests assert documented HTTP responses and domain invariants. Checkout of a persisted empty cart and concurrent 409/503 conditions require separate integration/concurrency tests. The collection writes to the configured local database.

item.name: 01-01 Initialize run and add first product

exec: pm.test("Estado del carrito correcto", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.cart.cart_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("cart_main")); pm.expect(body.cart.total_amount).to.eql(200); pm.expect(body.cart.products[0].quantity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.cart.products[0].unitAmount).to.eql(100); });

pm.test("Cart GET contract", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("cart_main")); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.currency).to.eql("EUR"); pm.expect(b.items[0]).to.include({quantity:2,unitPrice:100,total:200}); });

item.name: 01-03 Add same product: increment quantity, preserve original price

exec: pm.test("Estado del carrito correcto", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.cart.cart_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("cart_main")); pm.expect(body.cart.total_amount).to.eql(500); pm.expect(body.cart.products[0].quantity).to.eql(5); pm.expect(body.cart.products[0].unitAmount).to.eql(100); });
